title: Exported variable set to null in scene file, when saving script with error
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in:
v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da]
v4.6.2.rc1.official [257ac3532]
v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

This issue was encountered when copying code from a tutorial, that uses spaces as indentation.

Issue:
The scene file saves an exported variable as `null`, ex: `a = null`
- when the scene with the attached script is the focused tab
- the attached script is open
- the exported variable has the default value
- and the script has an error. Even if the error is corrected on save, ex:
Editor Settings > General > Text Editor > Behavior > Files > Convert Indent on Save

Expected:
Don't save the exported variable in the scene file as `null`


### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [exported-var-set-to-null.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25997947/exported-var-set-to-null.zip)
- in the scene panel, select `Node2D`
- in the inspector, note that the exported var `A` is set to `1`
- open the attached script: `node_2d.gd`
- note the variable `a`'s default value is set to: `1`
- run the project
- the output panel shows `1` (the expected value)
- open the scene file `node_2d.tscn`, in a text editor that shows when the file is updated on disk, ex: vscode
- the scene file `node_2d.tscn` looks like this:
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://cxex1kujlile1"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://bbyitqvbj0h4u" path="res://node_2d.gd" id="1_wtcfe"]

[node name="Node2D" type="Node2D" unique_id=1571591261]
script = ExtResource("1_wtcfe")

```
- copy the code below, the second line is indented with four spaces
```
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    pass
    
```
- back in Godot, paste it at the bottom of the script
- the script editor shows:
> Error at (6, 37): Used space character for indentation instead of tab as used before in the file.
- save the script: `ctrl + s` or `file > save`
- the scene file has a new entry: `a = null`
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://cxex1kujlile1"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://bbyitqvbj0h4u" path="res://node_2d.gd" id="1_wtcfe"]

[node name="Node2D" type="Node2D" unique_id=1571591261]
script = ExtResource("1_wtcfe")
a = null

```
- run the scene

Issue: the output panel shows: `<null>`

Expected: the scene file shouldn't store the exported variable as `null`, since the exported variable hasn't changed.

Workaround:
The `null` assignment is removed from the scene file:
- when a scene with an attached script is the focused tab
- the attached script is open
- the script doesn't have an error
- the script has been modified, so that it has something to save (see note below)
- and the scene is saved: `ctrl + s`

Note:
The script only needs to be modified to remove the `null` assignment, if the scene and the script are closed and reopened.

The `null` assignment can be removed without modifying the script, by resaving the script right after it was saved with the error.

In this state the `null` assignment can be toggled with:
- create a script error (ex: four spaces instead of a tab, when the script already has a tab indent)
- save the script (`ctrl + s`)
- `null` is assigned to the exported variable in the scene file
- save the script (`ctrl + s`)
- the `null` assignment is removed from the scene file
- undo (`ctrl + u`) to recreate the error

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[exported-var-set-to-null.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25997947/exported-var-set-to-null.zip)
